product.name: Southwest Rapid Rewards Priority Credit Card

benefits.name: Anniversary bonus points
benefits.notes: 7,500 Rapid Rewards points on each cardmember anniversary. Recorded as a perk because it posts automatically and cannot be forfeited.

benefits.name: Upgraded boardings
benefits.notes: The $75 Southwest travel credit and the four upgraded boardings were removed after 2025-12-31 when the annual fee rose to $229. This card now carries no recurring statement credits.
